mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 1.5%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession, a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a worsening supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM during a recession.
